Product Features

  • Size and shape: The cylindrical design with a diameter of 70 cm and a height of 35.5 cm takes up little space in the living room and does not take up too much space, so it is suitable for living room layouts of different types of apartments.
  • Swivel table top: The upper part of the table top can be rotated freely through 360 degrees. After placing the tea set and fruit platter, you can easily remove the items from different positions, making the living room more convenient to use.
  • Light Atmosphere: Equipped with LED light strips, you can create a warm and cozy atmosphere when watching movies by adjusting the light color, and switch to vivid and colorful mode during gatherings to add a different atmosphere to the living room.
  • Double-layer Structure: The two-layer structure design allows you to place frequently used items on the upper work surface, while books, magazines, etc. can be placed on the bottom surface, achieving multi-layer storage and making the items look neater in the living room.
  • Painting technique: The surface is painted using paint spraying technology, the paint is uniform and rich in texture and also has a certain resistance to wear. Even after prolonged use, it remains as beautiful as new.
  • Material Load Capacity: Due to the limitations of the product structure, please do not place heavy objects on the edge of the table for your safety and that of your family. The center of the table can support 30 kg and the edge can hold 15 kg. No objects can be placed on the edge. Please do not sit on the table and please do not use the table as a ladder.
  • Safety Design: The cylindrical rounded shape with no sharp edges reduces the risk of family members being injured by collisions, and is very family-friendly for the elderly or children.
  • Style Customization: The plain white cylindrical appearance is suitable for a variety of interior styles such as modern, Nordic and minimalist, and can be easily integrated into various living room decoration environments.
  • Space utilization: In limited space, several functions such as rotation, storage and lighting can be realized to make effective use of the living space and improve the practicality and aesthetics of the space.
  • USB Powered – Comes with a 5V 2A USB cable (USB plug not included) that can be connected to your TV, computer, power bank, etc. Safe and easy to use indoors

Descriptions

If the lights do not work, please check the following:

1. iOS and Android systems can download the "LotusLantern" app by scanning the QR code. To do this, open a browser or other tool with the "Scan QR Code" feature and scan the "LotusLantern" QR code (the QR code is in the user manual). 2. Click on the LotusLantern app icon to open the app page. 3. If Bluetooth is not enabled in the app interface, you will see the message "An application wants to enable the Bluetooth function of this device". Click 'Allow.' 4. Simply stick the light strip to a clean, dry surface with the self-adhesive backing. Use the included tape to improve adhesion. Please test the LED light strips before installation and install them carefully. If you have any questions, please contact us.

Description

This cylindrical coffee table with a diameter of 70cm and a height of 35.5cm is made of MDF and is treated with paint spraying technology. The paint is uniform, textured and wear-resistant. It requires little space and is suitable for many types of houses. The top table top rotates 360 degrees, making it easy to remove items. The two-layer structure allows for layered storage, so that items can be stored in an orderly manner. It is equipped with LED light strips to create different atmospheres. The rounded shape has no sharp edges and is safe and comfortable. The simple white appearance suits different styles such as modern and Nordic. It integrates functions such as rotation, storage and creating an atmosphere in a limited space, effectively improving the practicality and aesthetics of the living space. The recommended total load capacity is 30 kg and everyday objects can be placed stably.
